title: INVESTIGATIONS IN AUDIO CAPTIONING: ADDRESSING VOCABULARY IMBALANCE AND EVALUATING SUITABILITY OF LANGUAGE-CENTRIC PERFORMANCE METRICS

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the cumulative distribution of word frequencies in the training data versus the model's output vocabulary to identify token frequency imbalances, and addressing this bias by modifying the loss function using balanced cross-entropy and focal loss.

Evaluating the suitability of language-centric performance metrics by introducing specific perturbation errors (semantic, temporal, and spatial order alterations) to test if metrics appropriately penalize syntactical and structural errors in audio captions.
